propositions: inbound_probe.py currently contains Jira-specific REST mechanics (URL construction, basic-auth GET, status-name classification) and must be vendor-neutral to comply with epic AC3 (zero adapters.jira imports in core)

Jira probe mechanics (REST URL shape, auth resolution, status classification) must be relocated to adapters/jira/probe.py and wired through a SupportsAbsenceProbe capability protocol to allow alternative backends to implement their own probe without modification to core

run_differs.py currently calls probe_mod.probe() directly before loading the backend; the backend must be loaded earlier and the probe call must be guarded by isinstance(backend, SupportsAbsenceProbe) to route through the capability
Neutral vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) remains in root inbound_probe.py; core code loading by filename (ADR 0035) is preserved
A backend without SupportsAbsenceProbe capability must degrade to ProbeResult(UNREACHABLE) — the conservative branch that route_inbound_probe already handles for safe retry
AST neutrality gate must verify zero adapters.jira imports in inbound_probe.py; probe classification behavior must remain byte-identical for Jira across all branches
